content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I'm experiencing trouble updating my [product_name] software on my MacBook Pro running OS X 10.9.5. I've downloaded the update zip, extracted it using Stuffit Expander, and tried to run the Setup Application, but nothing happens when I click the icon. I've already set application permissions to 'anyone', so I don't believe it's a security issue. Has anyone faced a similar problem?

Hello [user_name], Have you tried these steps? After downloading, double-click the Setup application for Mac OS X. Notes: • Requires Mac OS X 10.6 Snow Leopard, Lion, Mountain Lion, or Mavericks • Ensure Java 1.5 or newer is installed, available from Oracle's site • The installer should be recognized and expanded automatically by Stuffit Expander; if not, expand it manually using Stuffit Expander 6.0 or later • If launching the installer fails after extraction, double-check it was expanded using Stuffit Expander. If you still encounter issues, contact technical support.
Hi [user_name], Yes, I've followed all of those instructions. It seems the installer simply refuses to start!

I recently downloaded and installed the file on my laptop without issues. Not sure what else to suggest. Try downloading the file again and repeat the installation from scratch. If it still doesn't work, consider submitting a support request.

That's unusual. I've attempted the installation multiple times without success. I also initiated a support request but received the same advice you just offered. Hopefully, I can find a solution soon.
If possible, try downloading the file on another operating system, then transfer it to your Mac before attempting the installation again.
[user_name], you're brilliant! Downloading and extracting the file on a Windows PC did the trick—the installer worked perfectly on the Mac after that. Thank you so much!
You're welcome, [user_name]. Honestly, I suspected it could be related to this kind of issue—I've had similar experiences with other software previously.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered an issue where the [product_name] installer would not launch on MacOS after extraction. Extracting the installer on a Windows PC and transferring it to MacOS allows successful installation. The process is frustrating due to the installer’s lack of clear error messages or diagnostic feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] installer to start and run successfully on MacOS after following the provided installation instructions.
